title: Page 5
content_zh:
莫札特呵，曲子流传过千百年，见证了无数段爱情，那么，就请你为阿誉和晴天再次见证……
蒋誉买早餐回来，一进屋看见的就是这幕。
他傻了，误以为时空穿梭，他的旋转女孩回来，在他的眼前轻笑、旋转，自信的她、自信的舞步，自信的晴天……回来……
音乐持续跑着，她舞得淋漓尽致，调皮的娃娃，调皮地蹬腿、跳脚，从东边跳到西边、从南跳到北，这是娃娃的夜晚，娃娃的世界。
在小小的一方橱窗中间，在月色朦胧、街灯沉默的夜，娃娃再不必担心过路客的眼光，她的心啊，荡漾春天。
跳跳舞得尽心，阿誉看得痴情，恍若那天、那年、无数个汗水淋漓的练习夜晚回来。
「橱窗娃娃」是晴天在舞蹈大赛中拿下冠军的作品，比赛之前，他当观众看过几十次，还说冠军非她莫属……
舞曲结束，跳跳发现他站在墙边，迅速挂起笑脸。
「阿誉记得对不对？」
她奔到他身边，抬头，对上一百九的特级身高，她懂了姊姊的哀嚎，和阿誉谈恋爱真的很容易得到颈椎疾病。
「跳跳也没忘记。」他的脸一贯臭，这种臭法不是臭豆腐吃太多，应该和妈妈怀孕时，跌进臭水沟有关系。
「没有人可以忘记晴天。」她伸出手指头，在他脸上揉捏，想替他揉出一个温和笑脸。
他不想伤感的，不想她从远方归来，看见他的忧愁，于是转移话题。「来，吃早餐。」
走进餐厅，他找出三百年没用过的餐盘，像办家家酒一样，排满整桌。
她笑笑，摇头。「我吃不下那么多。」
「能吃多少算多少。」她太瘦，瘦得不像记忆中的跳跳。
「嗯。」她用力点头，然后挪了一杯豆浆到面前，倒出小半杯，一口一口，慎重其事地慢慢喝掉，然后舔舔嘴唇说：「谢谢，我吃饱了。」
他瞠眼瞪她。
会不会太过份？十几人份的早餐摆在桌上，她居然只吃掉六分之一人份？「东西不合胃口？」
「没有，每样都好吃极了。」事实上，光看她就猛流口水，台湾的美食冠世界，离开多年，说不想念才有鬼。

「好吃为什么吃那么少？」
「身为舞者，身材很重要。」她举举杯子。「我吃这样已经很过份了，很多舞者是不吃早餐的。」
她属易胖体质，随便多吃两口，成效马上跑到肚皮上，她可不想害男舞伴骨折。
「这种吃法，哪有体力练舞？」
「阿誉先生不知道现代有一种叫做综合维他命的东西吗？」她笑眯眼。
「不行，多吃一点。」如果当知名舞星的代价是拿身体健康去交换的话，这种工作，不做也罢。
她看他一眼，为难的嘟嘴。「前阵子有个俄国的舞蹈明星，因为体重超过四十三公斤，就被解聘了。」
「不管，先吃，真到过胖的话，我再送你去健身机构减肥。」
看出他的坚持，好吧，反正舞星生涯和她……掀掀眉头，拚了。
把看起来很不错的三明治拿在手上，在阿誉的鼓励眼神下，她咬了一口，细细咀嚼。
「怎样？」
「人间美味。」
人间美味？不过是连锁店的早餐，她一定饿了很多年。「再试试这个。」他把一盘煎饺推到她面前，臭脸变得有点香了。
「好。」
她夹起饺子咬一口，肉汁流进嘴里，她满足的深呼吸。吃饱饱的生活……真棒，也许她该彻底改变生活方式。
「好吃对不对？」他喜欢她的表情，喜欢这个熟悉笑脸。
「好吃得不得了！」她用力点头，配一口豆浆。
再接再厉，她把松饼抹上奶油，咬一口，再把起司蛋饼含进嘴里，着迷的模样，像被封印三百年的小妖精，初尝食物精华。
见她吃得那么开心，蒋誉的心情也跟着放开。
商天雨直到撑了肚皮，才笑着摇手求饶。「我真的不行了。」

他看看剩下来的食物，不满意，但能接受。
他推开椅子，走到她身边，准备盘问她，他总得了解她跷家的理由，虽然他早猜到七八分，相信和她的新后母脱不了关系。
可突然，商天雨暴睁的眼珠子像看见鬼，捣起嘴巴，咿咿呀呀、比手划脚说着没有人听得懂的外星话，接着猛力推开他，往房间里面冲。
蒋誉满头雾水，跟在她身后进房间，右脚才跨进去，就听见厕所里面传来阵阵的呕吐声音。
食物不乾净？
不会，她吃过的，他都尝了。左边胸口一阵没道理的紊乱撞击，他被她弄慌了手脚。
「跳跳！」他追到厕所门前，扭动把手，发觉门被锁住。
门里传来一阵模糊的应话，他听不清楚。「跳跳，快点开门。」
她没空理他，他只好耳朵贴着门，细听里面的状况，幸好没多久，冲马桶的声音就响起，然后是水声，十秒钟不到，她
「放心啦，我没事。」
「吃坏肚子？」明知道不可能，他还是问。
「还好吧。」她看看天花板想了一下。
「食物不好？」
「还好吧。」正常人来吃，应该很好。
「怀孕了？」
「喂，阿誉在破坏我的名誉！」她用力捶他的胸膛。
「还有什么理由会让女人呕吐？」他失笑，因为她夸张的表情。
她说得笃定。「厌食症。」
「你有厌食症？」
「没这么严重，这是我们这一行的职业病，很多同事都有。」她笑笑，不以为意。

「可是长期下来……」
「我们才希望能够『长期下来』呢，很多得不到厌食症的人提早被迫离开舞台，就算再有天份、再有才华都没用。」她胡扯，而且越扯越顺口。
「说得好像得到厌食症是一种恩赐。」
「是啊。」她说谎，但谎话能换得他的眉头舒展，值得。
瞧，说谎多容易，她在飞机上东想西想，想着该怎么对他说谎，才能换到留下来的住宿券，没想到轻轻松松、简简单单，他就信了她每句话。
阿誉是个很好骗的人呢。她微笑。
「你可以吃些什么？」
「通常是生菜沙拉，和高纤低糖的水果。」
「这种生活不辛苦吗？」他眼里浮上一层心疼。
「有一点，不过我熬出头啦，阿誉知不知道，我很有名呢！」她骄傲的说。
「知道。」他看过关于她的报导。
很早以前，晴天说，跳跳学芭蕾的话太慢了，要成为芭蕾舞星，最慢在五岁之前就要开始接触芭蕾，所以他知道，跳跳拥有今天的成就，得比别人砸下更多努力。
她一直笑，好像心情很棒，棒到得用很多的笑容才能表达自己有多快乐，可是下一刻，突然他想起晴天的话——「跳跳啊，越伤心笑得越甜蜜，你不要被她骗了。」
才两个星期！
从发现晴天得到血癌到决定治疗方式，才经过短短两个星期，她整个人已经瘦掉六公斤，本来就不胖的她，变成一把骨头。
每天他都穿上无菌衣进隔离室，隔离室一次只可以进去一个人，他进去了，跳跳只好在窗外对他们微笑、做鬼脸。
「幸好跳跳还小，不知道你病得多严重，要是她知道，就不会笑得这么灿烂了。」他办不到，他做不出跳跳脸上的笑容。
「你不懂跳跳。」晴天说，对着窗外的跳跳比出一个V字的胜利手势。
「我哪里不懂？笨瓜一个，心思单纯得很。」
晴天微笑，说：「讲个故事给你听。」

「好。」
「我出生就笑味味，医生告诉爸爸别大惊小怪，那不叫做笑，而是颜面神经的反射动作，每个婴儿都有的。我爸爸却怎么看，都觉得我在对他微笑，于是帮我取了名字叫做天睛。」
content_en:
Mozart, the song has been circulated for thousands of years and has witnessed countless love affairs. So, please witness it again for Ayu and Qingtian...
Jiang Yu came back from buying breakfast, and this is what he saw when he entered the room.
He was stupid and mistakenly thought that time travel, his spinning girl came back, chuckled and spun in front of his eyes, her confident dance steps, confident sunny weather... came back...
The music continued to run, and she danced vividly. The naughty doll kicked her legs and jumped playfully, jumping from east to west, from south to north. This was the doll's night, the doll's world.
In the middle of a small window, on a night when the moonlight is dim and the street lights are silent, the doll no longer has to worry about the eyes of passers-by, her heart is full of spring.
Dancing with all his heart, Ayu looked infatuated, as if he had returned from that day, that year, and countless sweaty practice nights.
"Window Doll" was Qingtian's work that won the championship in the dance competition. Before the competition, he had watched it dozens of times as an audience member and said that she was the winner...
When the dance ended, Tiaodiao found him standing by the wall and quickly put on a smile.
"Ayu remembers it, right?"
She ran to his side, raised her head, and faced the super height of 19, she understood her sister's wailing. It is really easy to get cervical spondylosis when falling in love with Ayu.
"Tiaotiao didn't forget it either." His face has always been smelly. The reason for this stink is not because he ate too much stinky tofu, but because his mother fell into a smelly ditch when she was pregnant.
"No one can forget a sunny day." She stretched out her fingers and rubbed his face, trying to make him a gentle smile.
He didn't want to be sentimental. He didn't want her to come back from afar and see his sadness, so he changed the subject. "Come, have breakfast."
When he walked into the restaurant, he found plates that had not been used for three hundred years and lined them up around the table like a family wine.
She smiled and shook her head. "I can't eat that much."
"You can eat as much as you can." She was too thin, not as thin as Tiao Tiao in her memory.
"Yes." She nodded vigorously, then moved a cup of soy milk in front of her, poured out half a cup, drank it slowly and carefully, sip by sip, then licked her lips and said, "Thank you, I'm full."
He stared at her.
Would it be too much? Breakfast for more than a dozen people was placed on the table, but she only ate one-sixth of it? "Is the food not to your liking?"
"No, everything is delicious." In fact, just looking at her makes my mouth water. Taiwan's delicious food is the best in the world. It's been so long since I left it. It would be crazy if I didn't miss it.
"It tastes so good, why do you eat so little?"
"As a dancer, your body shape is very important." She raised her cup. "It's too much for me to eat like this. Many dancers don't eat breakfast."
She has a body that is prone to obesity. If she eats a few more bites, the results will immediately reach her belly. She does not want to cause her male dance partner to break his bones.
"How can I have the energy to practice dancing with this way of eating?"
"Mr. Ayu, doesn't he know that there is something called multivitamins in modern times?" She smiled and narrowed her eyes.
"No, eat more." If the price of being a famous dancer is to trade your health, then it's okay not to do this kind of work.
She glanced at him and pouted in embarrassment. "A while ago, there was a Russian dancing star who was fired because his weight exceeded 43 kilograms."
"No matter what, eat first. If you are really too fat, I will send you to a fitness center to lose weight."
Seeing his persistence, well, anyway, her career as a dancer and her... raised her eyebrows and gave it a try.
Holding the good-looking sandwich in her hand, under Ayu's encouraging eyes, she took a bite and chewed it carefully.
"How?"
"A delicious meal on earth."
Delicious food on earth? It was just chain breakfast, she must have been hungry for years. "Try this again." He pushed a plate of fried dumplings in front of her, and his stinky face became a little fragrant.
"Okay."
She picked up the dumpling and took a bite. The juice flowed into her mouth, and she took a deep breath of satisfaction. A well-fed life... awesome, maybe she should completely change her lifestyleMode.
"It's delicious, right?" He liked her expression and this familiar smile.
"It's delicious!" She nodded vigorously and took a sip of soy milk.
Keeping up her efforts, she spread butter on the muffin, took a bite, and then put the cheese omelette into her mouth. She looked fascinated, like a goblin who had been sealed for three hundred years and tasted the essence of food for the first time.
Seeing her eating so happily, Jiang Yu felt relieved.
Shang Tianyu didn't smile and wave his hands for mercy until his belly was full. "I really can't do it anymore."
He looked at the rest of the food, dissatisfied, but acceptable.
He pushed away the chair and walked up to her, preparing to question her. He had to understand her reason for leaving home, although he had already guessed it and believed it had something to do with her new stepmother.
But suddenly, Shang Tianyu's eyes widened as if he had seen a ghost. He opened his mouth, babbling, gesticulating and speaking in alien language that no one could understand. Then he pushed him away violently and rushed into the room.
Jiang Yu was confused and followed her into the room. As soon as he stepped in with his right foot, he heard the sound of vomiting coming from the toilet.
Food is not clean?
No, he tasted everything she had eaten. There was an unreasonable and chaotic hit on the left side of his chest, and he was confused by her.
"Jump jump!" He chased to the toilet door, twisted the handle, and found that the door was locked.
There was a vague response from the door, but he couldn't hear it clearly. "Tiaotiao, open the door quickly."
She had no time to pay attention to him, so he had to put his ear against the door and listen carefully to what was going on inside. Fortunately, not long after, the sound of flushing the toilet sounded, and then the sound of water. In less than ten seconds, she
"Don't worry, I'm fine."
"A bad stomach?" He asked even though he knew it was impossible.
"It's okay." She looked at the ceiling and thought for a moment.
"The food is bad?"
"It's okay." For normal people to eat, it should be good.
"Pregnant?"
"Hey, Ayu is destroying my reputation!" She punched his chest hard.
"What other reason would make a woman vomit?" He laughed because of her exaggerated expression.
She said firmly. "Anorexia."
"Are you anorexic?"
"It's not that serious. It's an occupational disease in our industry, and many of my colleagues have it." She smiled and didn't take it seriously.
"But in the long run..."
"We only hope that it will last in the long term. Many people who are not suffering from anorexia are forced to leave the stage early. No matter how talented and talented they are, it is useless." She talked nonsense, and the more she talked, the smoother she became.
"Speaking as if having anorexia is a gift."
"Yes." She lied, but the lie could make him frown, which was worth it.
Look, how easy it is to lie. She was thinking about it on the plane, thinking about how to lie to him in order to get the accommodation voucher to stay. Unexpectedly, it was so easy and simple that he believed her every word.
Ayu is an easy person to deceive. She smiles.
"What can you eat?"
"Usually it's lettuce salad, and fruits that are high in fiber and low in sugar."
"Isn't this kind of life hard?" There was a layer of distress in his eyes.
"A little, but I managed to survive. Does Ayu know that I am very famous?" She said proudly.
"I know." He had read reports about her.
A long time ago, Qingtian said that Dou Dou was too slow to learn ballet. To become a ballet star, he had to start ballet before the age of five at the earliest. So he knew that Dou Dou had to work harder than others to achieve what he has achieved today.
She kept smiling, as if she was in a great mood, so great that she had to use many smiles to express how happy she was. But the next moment, he suddenly remembered Qingtian's words - "Tiaotiao, the sadder the sweeter the smile, don't be fooled by her."
Only two weeks!
From the time she found out that Qingtian had blood cancer to the time she decided on treatment, she had already lost six kilograms in just two weeks. She, who was not fat in the first place, was reduced to a handful of bones.
Every day he puts on sterile clothes and enters the isolation room, only one person could enter the isolation room at a time, and when he went in, Tiaotiao had to smile and make faces at them outside the window.
"Fortunately Tiao Tiao is still young. I don't know how serious your illness is. If she knew, she wouldn't smile so brightly." He couldn't do it, he couldn't put the smile on Tiao Tiao's face.
"You don't understand Tiaotiao." Qingtian said, making a V-shaped victory sign to Tiaotiao outside the window.
"How do I not understand? I am a fool with a very simple mind."
Sunny smiled and said, "Let me tell you a story."
"Okay."
"I was born with the smell of laughter. The doctor told my father not to make a fuss. It's not called laughter, but a reflex action of the facial nerve, which every baby has. But no matter how he looked at it, my father felt that I was smiling at him, so he named me Tianqing."
